title: Interrupted Story? The Guide Picks It Back Up | vitalii.no
description:
A quick story plays as you pass a place along the drive — but the fuller version behind it often got cut short when the drive moved on. If another place took priority and interrupted that story, there was no way to pick it back up. It was simply lost, and street names kept repeating on every single pass instead of being said once and remembered.

A new pickPassed() method in DriveService.java now checks whether anything is due in the next 40 seconds of road. If not, and a place was passed within the last minute and no more than 2.5 km back, it plays the rest of that story — opening with a spoken lead-in cue and, if the story had been interrupted, a dedicated "back to the story" line that resumes it instead of restarting or dropping it. Street-name announcements are now throttled to once every two hours.

Empty stretches of road now get the rest of a story instead of silence, interrupted episodes resume instead of being lost, and street-name repetition dropped from every pass to once every two hours.
